question_or_proposition: For the Flow row in Part I Section A, do the 'Report MGD' entries in the 30-day average, daily maximum, and 7-day average columns establish enforceable numeric discharge limits for flow compliance comparison, or do they establish only non-enforceable reporting obligations with no applicable numeric limit for exceedance determination?
required_context: Full Flow row including 'Report MGD' in the 30-day average, daily maximum, and 7-day average columns and '***' in the corresponding concentration-limit columns
Measurement frequency 'Continuous' and sample type 'Totalizing Meter' on the same row
Section header 'FINAL Effluent Limits – 6.67 MGD Design Flow' on the preceding page
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, Page: 4, Section: part_i, Flow row
notes: Resolution of whether 'Report MGD' denotes report-only monitoring versus an enforceable numeric cap determines whether reported flow measurements receive limit-exceedance evaluation (Purpose A), which flow-metric reporting obligations are in scope (Purpose B), and how absent flow results are classified when monitoring was expected (Purpose C).
